name: Barbell Box Squat
steps: Stand just ahead of a flat bench with a barbell across your upper back and your feet set slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your core firmly and sit your hips smoothly backward as you bend your knees.
Settle lightly onto the bench with vertical shins, pausing briefly without relaxing your core or rocking back.
Drive forcefully through your feet and hips to stand straight back up with the bar over your midfoot.
tips: Keep your trunk tightly braced as you touch down rather than collapsing onto the bench.
Keep your knees pushed out in line with your toes as you drive off the bench.
